name: Indonesian
modelReview: artifacts only, no renderer yet: written 2026-11-19 by Claude Fable 5.2 from usage notes written in Indonesian with no knowledge of cron; a rule book (answers.md) derived from them, a lexicon, and hand-written rows (87 visible, 153 held out, 360 hard cases, 38 option rows), none produced by running a renderer. The rows pass the grid oracle (coverage, no duplicate, equal schedules worded alike). Read once, 2026-11-19, by a blind judge briefed only in Indonesian (114 sentences, every reading of each) and by an adversarial schedule read of all 637 rows; no row stated a wrong schedule under its intended reading, three sentences had a real second reading and several devices a weak one. Revised the same day on those reads: no «ke-0» and no minute named as a stretch; the «pada jam yang dimulai pukul», «berulang setiap», «masing-masing … sepanjang menit itu» and «… dan setiap N bulan sesudahnya» devices removed; a month or year of a union after «keduanya»; conditions said positively («tetapi … hanya jika jatuh pada»); a count back from the month's end said as its date where the date is fixed; a run of weekdays with no «setiap» and wherever it lies in the week; hour 0 on the 12-hour clock as «12 dini hari». About 240 rows changed; the changed forms have had no independent read, and nothing has had a native read. Devices with no corpus support found: «setiap N jam mulai pukul» with several first times, «setiap kali … sampai detik ke-59», «setelah pukul», «keduanya pada», «lalu setiap N tahun», «digeser ke hari …»; the parts of the day of the 12-hour style have no official bounds and are the author's
